def solve(I, bg):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r if x!=bg)
    # assume exactly two colors; the 2x2 square is the 'box'
    c1=[c for c in cnt if sum(sum(r.count(c) for r in I) for r in [I])]  # placeholder
    sizes={c:sum(r.count(c) for r in I) for c in cnt}
    box=min(sizes,key=sizes.get)   # smaller count -> box? demo: box=6(4 cells) vs 1s(6) -> box is smaller? no, 4<6 yes
    other=[c for c in cnt if c!=box][0]
    def refl(cells,axis):
        out=set()
        for (i,j) in cells:
            if axis=='v': out.add((i, 2*box_center_c - j))
            else: out.add((2*box_center_r - i, j))
        return out
    bcs=[(i+j) for i,j in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==box]]
    br=sum(i for i,_ in bcs)/len(bcs); bc=sum(j for _,j in bcs)/len(bcs)
    boxcells={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==box}
    oc={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==other}
    ov=refl(oc,'v'); oh=refl(oc,'h')
    return [[I[i][j] if I[i][j]==bg or I[i][j]==box else box for j in range(W)] for i in range(H]], None

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # box = the color whose cells form a tight square; try both
    best=None
    for b in cs:
        cl=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==b]
        rs=[i for i,_ in cl]; cc=[j for _,j in cl]
        if len(set(rs))==len(set(cc))==2 and len(cl)==4: best=b; break
    b=best; o=[c for c in cs if c!=b][0]
    oc=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==o]
    bc=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==b]
    br=(min(i for i,_ in bc)+max(i for i,_ in bc))/2
    bc_c=(min(j for _,j in bc)+max(j for _,j in bc))/2
    ovl={(i,int(2*bc_c-j)) for i,j in oc}
    ohl={(int(2*br-i),j) for i,j in oc}
    out=[[I[i][j] if I[i][j] not in (o,) and I[i][j]!=b else b for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    for i,j in ovl|ohl: out[i][j]=o
    return out
